g.text: Story Game — from running story_game.py through every file it touches
1 · Setup — load YOLO, build the Character, start the camera
2 · Greeting — what EVERY gigi.run_character(...) call does under the hood
3 · Find the prop with the camera (loop, up to 30 s)
4 · Confirm the prop — listening + LLM fallback
5 · Story loop — repeat until the child says "the end"

text.tspan: (app path: 'run story_game' → process_command_line() → find_script() → start_script() → subprocess.Popen)

g.text: Speech() loads TTS (Nix-TTS on robot / Silero on Windows) · Viseme(face, speech)
Movement() → PCA9685Controller() · home_position() (robot only: HAS_MOVEMENT = IS_ROBOT)
Hearing() loads STT (SenseVoice on NPU / faster-whisper on PC) + webrtcvad
Conversation() picks LLM URL from config.IS_ROBOT

text.tspan: generate_viseme_sequence(text) → mouth shapes from audio envelope

g.text: BASIC_GESTURES (gesture_definitions.py) → smooth_sequence() → move_motors() → set_pwm() over I²C
combine_seuqences() · generate_face(start_time=audio start) → lip-synced face on screen
holds a toy up to the camera
run_character('Oh! I see you brought a {prop}! ...')
move_motors({torso, neck}) — keep looking at the child
if not confirmed: gigi.conversation.get_response('Extract the toy name…', text)
"...and then the dinosaur flew to the moon!"
clean_response() · keep first sentence · append to story_history
run_character(sentence, random gesture: open_arms / clap / look_from_side_to_side)
run_character('The end! You are a great storyteller!', 'clap') · goodbye ('wave_hello')
process exits → daemon _monitor_lifecycle() → completion callback to app
